name: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch
description: A chest opener using a PVC pipe from a half-kneeling position. It loosens tight pecs and the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
